notes:
Account background: Sunward Answers Ops is a mid-stage SaaS player focused on customer support automation. They run an internal KB with ~1.8M documents (long-form troubleshooting + call transcripts).

Primary pain: retrieval quality degrades on long-tail issues; current system uses BM25 + static sentence-embedding reranker but misses context, so CS agents escalate often. They want a practical rerank strategy (fast vector retrieval -> lightweight re-ranker or two-stage cross-encoder) to balance precision vs cost.

Performance targets & constraints:
- Peak QPS: 350-450 (holiday peaks up to ~600 for promotions).
- P50 retrieval+rerank latency target: <= 200ms for first-pass retrieval, <= 400ms end-to-end for user-facing support suggestions.
- Indexing: moderate scale, currently ~1.8M docs, expected growth to 3M in 12 months.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement mandates scenario with per-query cost ceilings (target <$0.06/query at 400 QPS for full flow).

Tech preferences & asks from SEs: use hosted API now, but need clear migration path to VPC/Dedicated later. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: quantization suggestions, batching window tuning, and prefix/KV cache for repeated conversational flows. Also asked about hybrid retrieval (BM25 + ANN) and native rerank throughput numbers.

Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO SAML mandatory, subset of KB must remain in EU for GDPR (data residency). KMS integration for any persisted embeddings is desired.

Stakeholders: Head of Product (Eva Clarke) cares about UX metrics (reduction in escalations). CTO (Marcus Lee) cares about unit economics. Procurement requires 3 vendor quotes and strict cap modeling.

Quotes from calls: "We only take action if latency drops and per-incident cost is predictable." — Eva Clarke.

Open items: need SAML metadata exchange (pending), legal to confirm EU residency options, Redwood to provide detailed cost model for 200/400/600 QPS with and without rerankers.

Short-term plan: schedule 72-hour POC (stress at 400 qps) on hosted API with sample dataset; run three cost scenarios; provide reranker latency/cost tradeoff doc.
